turns.question: What share of our revenue from 1 to 10 October 2026 came from repeat customers?
turns.answer: Repeat customers (those with two or more orders in all) accounted for 86.6% of revenue (non-cancelled orders) from 1 to 10 October 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
